newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU olive oil producers demonstrate against reform.
newsitem.headline: EU olive oil producers demonstrate against reform.

text.p: European olive oil producers demonstrated outside the European Commission's Breydel building in Brussels on Wednesday against the Commission's plan to reform the EU olive oil regime.
Hundreds of Portuguese, Greek and Spanish producers waved placards and shouted in a good-humoured demonstration while their leaders met with officials.

COPA and COGECA, the European farm umbrella organisations, who organised the protest, say that the reforms to be proposed this month by Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler will lead to a reduction in both quality and incomes.
The two organisations favour granting producer aid on the basis of quality and continuation of the current intervention system.
The Commission has often said that the highest levels of agricultural fraud are in the olive oil sector.

"A proposal has not yet been produced," Commission spokesman Gery Kiely told reporters. "The producers' representatives met with officials. At this stage discussions at an official level are appropriate because it is a technical and not a political problem."
